skills.detail:
A long-range area attack with a Knockback effect.
Sets a mid-range area attack with a chance to inflict a SPD debuff and Confuse.
Increases own SPD.

The attack you set ignores obstacles.
The attack you set is removed after a certain period of time, or when you are KO'd.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.

skills.detail:
When the enemy has a Treasure Area:
Moves the user to the nearest enemy Treasure Area.
A mid-range multiple hit attack that attracts the enemy to your current position.

When the enemy has no Treasure Area:
A mid-range multiple hit attack that attracts the enemy to your current position.

Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
This skill cannot be used in certain areas that have obstacles overhead.
There is a cooldown in effect for a set period of time at the start of battle.
